title: Taking up trumpet and forming his first band
summary: His father taught him vocal music and he had piano lessons; in 1919 he chooses trumpet, studies three years at W.L. Jackson's school and starts an amateur band.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: Back home in school Dad taught me how to read vocal music. I took also piano lessons; dropped piano after leaving home.

1919 in Chicago I decided I was going to take up music and I decided that the instrument would be trumpet. I made arrangements with W.L. Jackson Music School which was the most popular school on the south side of Chicago in those days. I stayed with him three years; this is 1922 now.

After that I organized my own amateur band, started playing for small parties; rented a hall, promoted weekend dances, catering to high school kids. It was rough but I survived. All through this I was working every day in the stock-yard.
